_about: Copy to qualien-mcp.config.json (or pass --config <path>). Servers here merge over the built-in defaults (playwright, filesystem); a key you redefine wins, and `enabled: false` turns a default off. Tools are namespaced <server>__<tool> to the host.

tools._comment: Optional curation — fewer tools = better host tool-selection.

github._about: Remote OAuth server. Each USER logs in with their OWN GitHub via `qualien-mcp login github`. GitHub does NOT support dynamic client registration, so register a GitHub OAuth App (Settings → Developer settings → OAuth Apps) with callback http://127.0.0.1:41999/callback and put its Client ID below.
